{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|gr1= Containers

|gr2= Unit Inventory

|descr= Get array with all magazines from backpack of the given unit.

|s1= [[backpackMagazines]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Array]] of [[String]]

|x1= <sqf>
